target: Remediate various bugs in compose.yml, cli.py, catalog.py, and configurator.py that cause startup hangs and crashes when launching a wizard-less orchestrator role session.
invariants: Preserve dopemux split authority boundaries per AGENTS.md §6.
Do not print or persist provider secret values.

commit.message: fix(cli): resolve wizard-less orchestrator startup hangs and configurator crash

pr.title: fix(cli): resolve wizard-less orchestrator startup hangs and configurator crash
pr.body:
## Summary
- Comments out the redis-ui service from compose.yml to bypass registry hangs.
- Fixes Live display collision in cli.py.
- Resolves unexpected keyword argument 'role' in configurator.py.
- Modifies Zen MCP server from required to optional in catalog.py.

validation: No errors when launching dopemux start --role orchestrator
